يعتذرن (form VIII)

# يُعْتَذَرْنَ (yuʕtaḏarna) /juʕ.ta.ðar.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
